description: Use this for new customer bookings from an external agent, whether the customer already has a Homejourney account or not. After the customer confirms the selected provider package, the exact price, schedule, address, customer-provided email and mobile number, and contact consent, it returns one branded Homejourney review-and-authorization link. No OTP is required. The customer saves a card there for the exact booking, or chooses PayNow. Tell the customer: "Nothing is charged or held now. We charge your card, or send a PayNow request, after the job is done." The booking appears in the Homejourney account of the customer once they sign in with the same verified email or WhatsApp number. When someone else lets the technician in, such as a tenant, add them as onsite_contact.

catalog_version_id.description: The chosen package's catalogVersionId from search_services.

address.description: The service address with its postal code. Required for every service except moving, which takes pickup_address and delivery_address instead.

delivery_address.description: Required for moving: where the move ends, with its postal code.

pickup_address.description: Required for moving: where the move starts, with its postal code.

extras.description: Optional extras from the quote's availableExtras, each id once with a quantity up to its maxQuantity. Each is charged at the operator's price and leaves the visit's length and start as quoted.

host.description: The AI app making this call, such as chatgpt or claude. It records where the request came from; it is not the listing owner or agent.

number_of_hours.description: Hours booked, for an offering priced per hour. The provider may charge a minimum number of hours.

onsite_contact.description: Optional. The person at the address who lets the technician in when the customer won't be there, such as a landlord's tenant. Only the business assigned to the job sees it, until the job closes; the customer still gets every update and the charge. Send it only after the customer confirms that person agreed to be contacted.

platform_unit_count.description: Retired: Homejourney no longer offers its own catalog prices, so a launch_guide selection is refused. Leave it out.

price_source.description: The chosen package's priceSource from search_services.

property_size.description: Home size, for an offering priced by home size. A quote without it names the sizes the provider prices.

provider_id.description: The chosen package's providerId from search_services.

provider_package_id.description: The chosen package's providerPackageId from search_services.

service_details.description: The chosen package's serviceId from search_services, such as leak-repair. Put the customer's own words in issue_description.

singapore_time.description: Exact customer-selected Singapore start time in 24-hour HH:mm format. Do not send a time range.
